fields.summary_ko.0: Tesla (TSLA) average analyst rating is 3.67 (on a 1–5 scale), the highest since early 2023, with Barclays raising its target price from $370 to $450.
fields.summary_ko.1: ARK Invest maintains a 2031 target price of $4,400, with robotaxi accounting for approximately 80% of enterprise value and Optimus robot expected to contribute about 14%.
fields.summary_ko.2: Q3 FSD (Full Self-Driving) adoption surged from 55% to above 75%, with consensus 12-month target price at $409.27, suggesting upside of approximately 10%.
